info.name: Digital Signage
info.summary: Display calendars, event descriptions, weather and media slideshows on public screens
info.description:
Transform Nextcloud into a professional digital signage solution
Display calendar events, weather information and media slideshows (images and videos) on public screens without requiring login. Perfect for offices, schools, shared spaces and reception areas.
**Key Features:**
- **Calendar Integration** – Display upcoming events from multiple Nextcloud calendars - **Event Descriptions** – Optionally show sanitized calendar descriptions below events, limited to three lines - **Media Slideshows** – Automated playback of images (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP) and videos (MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV) from Nextcloud folders - **Video Support** – Native HTML5 video playback with muted autoplay and automatic transitions - **Weather Information** – Real-time weather data via Open-Meteo API - **Customizable Appearance** – Configure layout, colors and font sizes per text class - **Preset System** – Switch media folders, crop modes, intervals and display settings remotely - **Smart Event Filtering** – Hide specific events with autocomplete-enabled exclusion - **Multi-Display Support** – Manage multiple displays with separate tokens and preset assignments - **Remote Control** – Change presets through the control API without UI access - **Public Access** – Dedicated view tokens for displays without login requirement - **Multi-Language** – Available in English, German (formal/informal), French, Dutch, Spanish, Italian
**Perfect for:** Reception screens, meeting room displays, office dashboards, school information boards, team calendars, shared workspace displays.
info.author: Lukas Märtin
